verdict: New composition for the Side Project scene (issue 05): the front bar and its navy wall of bottles, nearly face-on, replacing the entry view, because the ten brands are now bottles with their logos on the back bar, not taps. Joe chose Codex draft b1 of six (a gentle three-quarter view; the ten brand bottles in one lit row on the lower shelf; the back bar's cooler with its chalkboard at the right). Round one, painted by construction, repainted the ten labels from the brands' logo files and hung a round Side Project sign with the light-bulb logo on the cooler door, which grants the beer mug. The ten bottles, the sign and the chalkboard are prop mattes and the two counters walk-behind scenery mattes, all measured from the master; scene data measured on it. Checks pass. The opening camera is centred on the sign (Joe). Workshop acceptance of the assembled scene and the walk-behind counters is Joe's, in art/review.html.
